messages.text: The district nurse sent another thread about the spring clinic. Can you look at the links before I forward anything to the family chat?
Send them. If it's the county page plus the Banner writeup, that's better than the Facebook screenshot Aunt Renee keeps reposting.
It has the county page, a CDC table, and something from Mayo. No random blog.
Those are the ones I'd use. I'll read Dr. Nguyen's portal note tonight too and tell you if anything conflicts.
You still good for AZ Bouldering Club at 6:30? The orange V4 got reset.
Yeah. I can do an hour, then maybe grab coffee after if my forearms still work.
Deal. Cold brew plus the Suns score on my phone if it stays close.
That is enough motivation to not flail on slab all night.
If that parking ticket is still annoying you, toss a story up with the crash pad sale. Climbers will bite.
I already texted Marcus and my dad about it. Keeping the feed for route pics and Suns jokes.
Fair. I can ask Eli at the gym tonight, too.
Appreciate it. I'll handle it through people I actually talk to.
You still making it to ABC tonight or did the new badge-life eat the evening?
Coming for 45. Had to finish benefits stuff and set the rent portal before I forget.
That is a very Tuesday way to become boring. Warm up easy, wrist first.
Fair. I also moved $300 into the house fund before I left so at least boring is useful.
You still coming to Mesa Rim tomorrow or did the tiny board with knights steal the evening again?
Keyboard wrist still mad or are you making it to the gym tomorrow?
Gym, then 20 minutes of chess puzzles. After today I need something with rules that do not change every standup.
Coming. I just needed ten minutes with a mate-in-two before touching that late bug.
Fair. I am doing easy routes only. You still doing that pre-sunrise trail thing Saturday?
Bring the wrist wrap then. Also your gym playlist from Saturday had robot bass into huge space-synth drama, which was weirdly good.
That mix is staying. Good for small squares and big maps.
Yeah. Shoes by the door, water frozen halfway, phone on silent after I finish a chapter.
That weather-sealed shell I sent you is on sale until Friday. Good for wind and spray if you are still building that cold-coast kit.
That packable rain shell I sent has pit zips and weighs under 11 oz. Better than paying for another logo hoodie.
Yeah, I bookmarked it. I am waiting until after the 15th when I move money into the plane/lodging line.
Yeah, I watched two breakdowns and checked the comments. People kept saying the zipper is the only weak spot.
Makes sense. Prioritize boots first. Camera gear does not matter if your feet are soaked.
Same method you use before buying tiny desk parts, huh.
Boots, rain cover, then maybe the wider lens. Trying to keep the ice lagoon and black-sand stops from turning into a dumb impulse-buy spiral.
Pretty much. If the switch opener and plate foam order ships tomorrow, the shell can wait.
Did the cheaper climbing pass work, or did they need one of those special IDs?
Regular adult rate. No extra card to show, so I just paid the $24 drop-in.
Saw another layoff note from a Tempe tech shop. Your place still looking steady?
Yeah, team is funded through the year and the benefits are still solid. I'm staying put while I stack cash and keep the side thing small.
Figured. You still doing that cloud routing chapter tonight?
Yeah, VPC notes after dinner. Trying to make the subnet diagrams stop looking like spaghetti.
Good. Small is fine if the bills and coverage are handled first.
That's the plan. Tonight is just mapping the request-intake mess at work into a tiny clickable demo.
Can you bring your laptop Sunday? My work login changed again and the board packet is stuck behind two different portals.
Yeah. Is this the one with the enrollment tables and principal signatures?
Exactly. Your dad also wants you to look at the ASU alumni password reset while you're here. His is worse than mine.
I'll do both after dinner. Tell him not to try the security questions ten more times.
That Lost Dutchman sunrise looked clean. Did you end up using the 24mm or crop it later?
24mm. I pulled the shadows down a little and made it a 4-frame carousel before work.
The saguaro one is the keeper. Also saw you saved that McDowell ridge loop from the trail account.
Yeah, saving it for a Saturday when the light and my legs both cooperate.
AZBC still has the cave wall reset from Monday. Want to try the green V4s at 7?
Yeah, but I am taping the left wrist first. Too much trackpad today.
You still doing Sunrise Peak before work Friday, or did deploy week eat that too?
Start easy then. Bring the small band and we will do warmups before touching the overhang.
Still going. Need an hour where the only dashboard is rocks and sky.
ABC waiver kiosk froze on my profile again. Did yours ask for the same old hospital-city security prompt?
Good call. I will leave the laptop closed by 6:20 and meet you there.
Yeah, it wanted the city from the original paperwork plus the month/day. I had to text my mom before it stopped rejecting me.
Fair. My knees vote for the shorter loop.
Classic. Also it opened in the other-language screen for me for no reason.
Short loop works. I told Mom I’d meet them after their 10:30 thing Sunday, so Friday is my quiet reset.
Same. I switched the kiosk back before signing the waiver. See you at 7.
Can you sanity-check me for 10 minutes? Work thing is spiraling and I don't trust my read.
You still awake or did the county PDF win?
Call me. And stop writing incident reports in your head before anything actually broke.
Barely. I got through the recorder page and two summaries, then bailed before the replies turned into a sewer.
Same voice you used on me during the ASU capstone repo meltdown.
Correct, because it worked. If this turns into HR/legal/real money, loop Angela and Robert after we sort the facts.
Very responsible tab management. What was the verdict?
Need one more source. The big slogans are useless unless the staffing and timeline math works.
Found a box from the Scottsdale house with your old debate medals and my terrible glitter notebook.
Please tell me that notebook is not entering public circulation.
Your blue-work-app post showed up between my cousin's hiring rant and a recruiter selfie lol
Great placement. I was trying to keep the auth rollout write-up useful without sounding like I was auditioning for a panel.
Angela said Robert kept all of it because "both kids might want it someday." Very dramatic archive energy.
Bring it Sunday. I want proof the glitter phase was real.
It sounded normal. Lots of diagrams though. Very you.
The diagrams are the part I want people to notice, especially the tradeoff section.
Your insurance card in the glove box current? They changed the PDF layout again.
Updated it after that old Loop 101 stop taught me not to trust expired paper copies.
Good. Also saw the city agenda has camera retention and stop-number reporting on it. You going?
Probably. I want to hear how they plan to publish the numbers, not just announce a dashboard.
I printed the county sample sheet for your mom. Some of those bond items are written like a warranty contract.
Send me a photo. I was going to read the League guide and the Chamber questionnaire before I mark mine.
Figures. Your friends will probably circle every new spending line and call it research.
Marcus already sent me three endorsements. I am still going race by race; some of the budget answers actually matter.
Are you still coming by Sunday, or did work spill into the night again?
Still coming. I closed Slack after the release notes and left the Jira cleanup for tomorrow morning.
Good. Eat something real before you start staring at those review comments again.
Already did. The Node endpoint and migration comments can wait until coffee.
Still doing 6:15 at EoS before we hit the wall, or did work eat it?
Calendar says lift, so laptop closes at 5:40. Wall after if my grip isn't cooked.
Good. Also no attempt spreadsheet tonight, just climb a few problems.
Deal. Forty-five minutes, coffee, then I am not ranking the evening.
You still in that PR stack or did you escape?
Still here. v2.4 got bumped again and the cart won over the chicken I thawed.
Your fridge is filing a bug.
Fair. I put a hard stop on the food apps after this week. Card looks dumb already.
Do you still have that old school file where you ranked paths by classes and money? I need the less dramatic version of my brain right now.
Yeah. Mine had columns for prereqs, sample job posts, salary ranges, and whether I wanted to spend eight hours making posters, editing clips, or building screens people actually used.
Send it after dinner? Also lol at you making a whole table instead of just asking one human.
The table kept me from romanticizing the Adobe lab too much. The paid campus metrics thing helped too.
You still good for bouldering at 11? I can swing by your gate off Hayden first if the pad is in your trunk.
Yeah. Give me ten to move the tripod case out from behind the shoes and grab the chalk bag from the entry shelf.
Your entry shelf has a better inventory system than most clinics.
Only because if one thing lands on the desk chair, the whole place feels off.
Pinnacle Peak parking fills early. Are you still taking the small pack or just water?
Small pack. I want the ankle sleeves too after yesterday's Gold's session.
Good. Check the tread on those shoes. Loose gravel on the east side.
Already swapped shoes. I'll screenshot the route so we don't lose time at the trailhead.
Are you stopping by the store before you come over tomorrow or should I grab charcoal?
Did you ever increase that paycheck percentage after the market dipped?
I'm doing Fry's this morning, so I can get it. Also grabbing enough stuff for a few boxes for the week.
Yeah, bumped it one point through Workday. Same check also shows the medical and dental lines, so I left the rest alone.
Good. For taxes, keep the extra forms simple if there aren't any other checks coming in.
Good. Check the propane too. Your mother said you were trying to keep tomorrow afternoon open.
That's how it looks. One payroll account, no extra forms in the folder Marisol asked for.
Yeah, I want the washer and kitchen handled before dinner so Monday isn't chaos.
Do you want me to bring an extra plate Sunday or are you still doing your usual one-pan thing?
One pan is enough. My fridge is already packed like a Tetris board after Costco.
Then I will send leftovers home in small containers. Also, please keep one evening clear this week that is not work or gym.
Wednesday is open. Keeping my own week intact is the whole point if I start making room for anyone new.
Did your portal forms go through before the appointment?
Yep. Mostly clicks through the same boxes, plus updating my emergency contact and pharmacy.
Good. And you still made your morning meeting afterward?
Yeah, I was at my desk by 9:40. Even squeezed in the gym after work instead of letting the release eat the whole day.
You still grabbing the new shoes before Saturday or waiting?
Waiting until rent and the car stuff clear. Feb landed at 4287 so I am keeping March closer to 3900.
Fair. We can just use my spare brush and tape for now.
That helps. I also already tucked some cash into the July/Aug APS line, so gear can wait.
Tom's Thumb lot looked packed when I drove by. You still doing that one tomorrow?
Yeah, but I'm rolling out at 5:50. If I wait until after breakfast, it's a bad idea.
Smart. Bring the bigger bladder, the exposed stretch after the saddle is brutal once the sun clears.
Already packed. I'll send you the route if the north side is less cooked.
You still have that county envelope on your counter? I saw three mailers at the house yesterday and they all made the same road promise.
Yeah, I kept mine. I am comparing the road piece against the water surcharge and the new apartments language before I fill anything out.
Good. The glossy ones never tell you who pays after year one.
Exactly. I am also checking who signed the public safety oversight statement because the wording is vague.
You still bringing something over tonight or should I put burgers on?
I have salmon in the oven and quinoa cooling. I can bring enough for two containers.
Works. Your mother said don't forget the little coffee plunger thing if you want your usual cup tomorrow.
Already packed it with the filters. I'll bring the salmon after it rests.
Gym pass renewal hit today. You still in for Thursday climbs or watching cash this week?
Thursday is fine. I already moved the paycheck chunk Friday morning, and the car draft is separate.
Responsible spreadsheet guy. Coffee after?
Coffee works. Keeping it cheap though; I had that $400 tire quote in the back of my head.
Your release thread sounded cursed. You going to do the vague late-night post thing?
Nope. I muted the app and called my mom for ten minutes.
Efficient. Human rollback plan.
Pretty much. You and her got the short version; everyone else can see the box score.
Before Sunday, remind me to grab the framed Sun Devil photo from the garage. Your mother wants it for that alumni breakfast.
The one with both of you in the old stadium?
That one. Also I may be late tonight. Two carriers missed dock windows and the west-side route board is a mess.
Got it. I'll tell Mom not to hold food if you're still untangling trucks.
Can you tell me if this message from the insurance site is something I should answer today?
Forward the screenshot, but cover the member number first. I can look between meetings.
Sent. Also, are you still okay with Sunday the 22nd for dinner here?
Yes, keep me on for the 22nd. I'll bring the little USB cable too.
You making 6:30 climbing or is the keyboard cave winning again?
Probably 7:15. Release branch slipped and I am already at 42.5 since Monday.
Cool, I will warm up on the easy wall. Wrist tape in my bag if you need it.
Thanks. Also waiting for Friday's account hit before I buy the new shoes, so do not let me impulse-order.
You alive or buried under tickets?
Alive. Clearing Slack, then Jira, then planning at 9. The Python job failed on a test fixture.
Classic. Was it the fake timestamp thing again?
Yep. Fixed the fixture, now the Postgres check is the one complaining.
Are you coming by Sunday after your usual workout, or should I keep dinner later?
Keep it at 6. I put the workout earlier so I do not turn Sunday into chores and tabs.
That sounds better. Bring yourself, not a project plan for the grill.
No grill roadmap. I might even let Dad choose the marinade.
You making 6:15 at the gym or should I start without you?
Start without me. Another RC patch window. I also have a burrito showing up at 7, so I'm probably not moving.
Keyboard shoulders again?
Yeah. I blocked Saturday morning for a trail instead. Need to get outside before I become furniture.
Coffee at Cartel after standup, or are you pretending Jira is a personality again?
Cartel at 5:40 works. I have a deploy window before that.
Cool. I will bring the terrible trade-machine idea and we can keep one eye on Suns tip.
As long as the idea is less cursed than last time.
Suns at 7. You doing the 6pm Gold's block again or actually arriving before tip?
I'll be there after. App says I only need 3 working sets today, so 7:15 is realistic.
Your spreadsheet has a body now. Terrifying.
It gave me +10 from last Thursday, so I respect it.
Your release thread looked cursed today. You alive?
You disappeared after standup. Please tell me you did not spend lunch optimizing opening turns again.
Barely. I closed Slack, queued one Civ run, and moved the Le Guin paperback to the couch like a serious recovery plan.
Only a little. Settled the worker order, then did three fork positions so I could stop replaying the meeting.
That is the most Donte incident response possible.
Classic Donte: empire spreadsheet, tiny-board penance, then code.
Worked though. Also your save is doomed if you ignore my scout.
If I am not answering after 9, assume the empire fell or the book won.
Found our old repo. You named the branch final-final-client-paid. Truly cursed.
That little admin panel covered groceries for a month and beat another semester of guessing between portfolio reviews and CS labs.
Did you survive your first on-call shadow or did the repo ask for a blood sample?
Survived. Got one PR merged and my manager sent the leveling rubric after standup.
I remember you updating that giant grid after the check cleared. Very normal behavior.
It changed the columns from hypothetical to real: client feedback, code, layout, and a paycheck.
Already reading the rubric. Classic. Next you will make a Jira ticket for your couch.
Couch ticket is blocked by the security deposit clearing. But yes, I want the bigger-scope path mapped early.
Did you see the recorder debate clip? The one my group chat likes is the only one who talked wait times.
Yeah, she was better there. I still need to read the other guy's ballot security answer before I pick.
Your spreadsheet brain refuses team sports even when the answer is obvious.
My parents have the opposite obvious answer, so the spreadsheet is keeping dinner civil.
Are you coming to coffee before Sunday dinner or doing your chalk-dust thing again?
Coffee first. The wall can wait until Monday.
Good, because last time you sat like a folded lawn chair after.
Desk week plus overhangs is a rude combo. I will bring the heat wrap for later.
Are you still doing your little forms-and-approvals lab after work or did basketball win
Halftime only. I fixed the part that sends reminders when someone leaves a request sitting too long.
That sounds useful but please do not quit your real check because of one working button lol
Relax. Real check and insurance stay untouched. This gets weekend hours until it earns its own oxygen.
Did the bank show what you expected this morning? I remember you said rent comes out of this one.
Yep, $2,850 landed. I moved rent and APS into the first column and left the car stuff for the 27th.
Good. Please still eat lunch today if they keep you in release meetings.
I blocked 12:30. Calendar is ugly but not impossible.
Your father asked if you looked at that school funding item yet. He only read the flyer.
I read the district budget note and the county writeup. Flyer skipped the maintenance backlog part, which is kind of the whole point.
That sounds like you. Send me the link when you can.
Will do. Also sent $25 to the food pantry match thing, but I want to check their annual report before doing more.
Gym at 7 tomorrow? Wrist okay after all the keyboard time?
Yeah. Used the vision appointment slot this morning and worked from home after, so the wrist got a break.
Nice. Still doing that cloud exam thing?
Booked it for the 27th. I need the receipt clean because work only covers part of it.
Saw you liked that thread about owning messy migrations. Collecting receipts?
More like studying how people explain decisions when six teams are affected.
So your lunch break is homework for bigger meetings. Extremely on brand.
If I want those rooms later, I should probably learn the language before I get tossed into one.
Suns at 7. You still coming over or did your apartment backlog win?
Coming after I wipe down the counters and run the vacuum. Future me needs the weekend less dumb.
You are literally grooming your apartment like a release branch.
If it buys me room to cook Sunday and not eat random drive-thru by Wednesday, yes.
Crescent tomorrow for Suns? They have that jalapeno pizza again.
I'm in. I'll probably do one lager then switch to Topo Chico. Want to be functional for climbing Sunday.
Responsible adult mode, tragic. Also, no mystery pen from Trevor this time?
Hard pass. Last time I just held it while he tied his shoe and smelled like a college couch for an hour.
Can I stop by before dinner and borrow that little ring light?
Mom said you had a whole tab group open about the board thing. Are you making a spreadsheet for people with yard signs again lol
Sure, it is in the lens bin under the desk. Do not move the pan from the left burner though, I already prepped tomorrow.
Not a spreadsheet. Just a notes doc. The board thing affects class sizes and those bond numbers are not small.
That is still spreadsheet energy.
Lol your place has stations. Work cave, food corner, sneaker wall, camera bunker.
That is the system. Also text when you are downstairs so I can meet you before the hallway gets loud.
Fair. I also added the 2022 and 2024 checklist format so I do not forget the small boxes this time.
Mom found that baby folder while looking for tax stuff. Your tiny bracelet from St. Joseph's is still in there lol
Of course she kept the bracelet. I only need the scan with the city line and date line for the MVD thing.
She also asked if you want the portal set to the same language as usual before she sends screenshots.
Yes, please. Otherwise the form labels slow me down.
Your grid is all cactus, rocks, and gym mirrors lately lol
Balance. One row outside, one row people reminding me I skipped leg day.
I did like the tan mountains one. Mom asked if that was from the road by Fountain Hills.
Close. Pulled over before work and posted it while the coffee was still too hot.
Saw your missed call come through after midnight. Everything stable this morning?
Yeah. I called Marcus first and he talked me through the immediate mess. Might still need your read if the insurance part gets bigger.
Good. Send photos and the policy number if it moves past a quick fix.
Will do. Marcus already made a checklist so I'm not improvising.
When you come by Saturday, check the garage shelf. Your yearbook and Maya's soccer trophy are still in the same bin.
That bin survived every move somehow.
Angela labeled it in 2017. Scottsdale stuff, school papers, photos from the old backyard.
I'll sort through it after I fix the printer.
Gym at 8 or you still doing the kitchen science first?
Ten more minutes. Press is dripping slow because I ground it too fine.
lol. Bring one of those rice bowls after? I'm not eating vending machine breakfast again.
I have chicken, peppers, and quinoa in the fridge. I'll grab an extra fork.
You still hitting the gym before ABC? Wrist okay after last night's tiny-screw marathon?
Gym first, then easy problems. I followed that mobility clip you sent and skipped the tray lube session.
Good. Also the r/Ultralight thread says Browns Ranch is sandy after the wind, so bring the shoes with grip.
Already packed those and the chalk bag. Leaving the new overshirt in the cart again.
Did you end up buying those microspikes or are they still living in research-tab purgatory?
Still in purgatory. I moved cash to the trip envelope first, so gear waits unless it drops under 70.
Responsible and annoying. Also, bring that polarizer to the gym Tuesday, I want to see if it fits my 67mm ring.
Deal. I need to test it before I trust it around bright ice and water anyway.
Group chat is arguing from screenshots again. You have the boring link stash?
Yeah. AZCentral has the local piece, KFF has the explainer, and Mayo's FAQ is cleaner than the thread.
Of course you have a stack ranked reading list.
Screenshots lose to pages with dates, authors, and corrections.
Suns at mine or yours? My couch has achieved peak tortilla-chip entropy.
Mine works if you leave after the postgame. I have the early gym block and exactly one functioning coffee mug.
A one-mug architecture. Bold. Does the new person from Hinge get a provisioning ticket?
Maybe eventually. Not merging calendars before I know they can respect leg day and Sunday code time.
You vanished after the game. Whiteboard cave?
Load balancer lab. I broke the diagram twice and then finally got the health checks to make sense.
Your Saturday nights are sponsored by architecture boxes.
No campus desk, no drill weekend, just me and the kitchen table losing to route tables.
Can I steal your boring budget tab format? My checking looks chaotic.
Yeah. Mine is just buckets: rent, Hyundai, Nelnet, groceries, fun, Ally.
Where do random disasters go in this beautiful prison
Ally buffer first. I keep enough there that a $400 surprise doesn't touch the card.
Saw the email about Lost Dog Wash parking changes. Might want to check it before you head over.
Good catch. I was going to use that lot Sunday and cut across the Taliesin overlook.
Start early. By the time the pavement starts throwing heat back, it's not worth proving anything.
Yep. Shoes by the door, pack in the fridge, alarm at 5:30.
We’ll be done around 11:45. Want me to save you a seat at brunch, or are you doing your mountain loop first?
Loop first, brunch after. I’m not useful in a pew, but I can be pleasant after some desert air.
That sounds like you. I’ll tell your dad noon at the usual place.
Thanks. I’ll bring those storage bins from the garage too.
Mom said you had Opinions at that library thing lol
I was calm. I just asked why complaint summaries can't be reviewed by people outside the department before they get archived.
That is such a Donte sentence.
Fair. Also I found my second old citation while cleaning the car folder, so now the folder is aggressively organized.
Insurance renewal posted yet?
Yeah, car note plus insurance hits this week. Rent already went out, groceries are next, then APS and gym.
Keep the tires on your list too. Heat will find any weak spots.
I set the March sheet at 3750 before tires. Also started padding the two high APS months so they do not surprise me.
Garage camera app says offline again. Router lights look normal.
Power cycle the small white box by the modem, not the modem itself. Wait two minutes.
Back up. When you're by here Sunday, show me which one is which.
Will do. Mom already texted me the dinner time.
Insurance portal is asking me to verify household info again. Yours still uses 06/14/2000, correct?
Correct. For the place field, use Phoenix like the old paperwork.
Got it. It also has separate ancestry and language pages. I left your prior selections alone.
Perfect. Same answers as last year is easiest.
Good morning. Are you still going out early tomorrow or did work steal your Saturday?
Still going. South Mountain before the sun gets rude, then breakfast and a few chapters somewhere quiet.
Please take extra water. And do not let that laptop follow you to breakfast.
Laptop stays home. Just the pack, hat, and the Kobo.
Your dad wants to talk school funding at dinner, but please do not let it turn into the Thanksgiving table again.
I will keep it boring. I only marked two of the four funding lines yes, so everybody can be mildly annoyed.
Maya said your friends were posting the full yes list. Your father sent me the full no list.
That sounds about right. I am bringing the actual pamphlet so we can argue with page numbers.
Dinner Sunday is 5:30. Also, did you ever finish comparing the health plan options from your job?
Yep, staying with the same plan. Predictable deductible, no surprises.
Good. And are you sleeping, or still turning office headaches into screen mockups at midnight?
Mostly sleeping. I only have a short list tonight: approvals, owner handoff, and one dashboard view.
Saturday morning still good? The black slab looked doable and the gym is less packed before noon.
Yep. I moved my monitor higher today so my shoulders are not wrecked before we start.
Bring the roller too. We can hit slab first, then one or two cave attempts if your hands are okay.
Deal. I am not repeating the full-send mistake from last week.
You liked three lifting clips and then sent me a canyon-color preset. Algorithm whiplash.
The app knows the full stack: squats, trail saves, and orange rocks.
Your carousel from Papago made my lunch scroll less bleak, so I will allow it.
High praise. I almost left that last frame out because the sky looked fake.
I saw your blank story draft in the screenshot lol. Were you actually going to post?
Typed three lines, deleted it. Easier to tell you at coffee than let random coworkers read half a thought.
Good. I want the director's cut, not the public trailer.
Coffee after Mom's on Sunday. You, me, and maybe Marcus if he stops pretending Tempe is another continent.
Coffee tomorrow or are you living inside Jira again?
Coffee works if we keep it before noon. This week is at 46 and I still have a Sunday deploy check.
I am making a tiny violin meme for your laptop.
Fair. Also remind me not to touch the card until the 27th column fills.
I walked by your desk and heard Tron drums plus that old space-movie synth thing. Are you okay lol
Yeah. Just doing five endgame diagrams before bed.
Five diagrams sounds like homework for a haunted calculator.
Better than doomscrolling. After that I might finish Marcus's space bug rush problem.
Insurance card came through for the car?
Yes. Also updated renter policy address and moved the utility bill to autopay.
Good. Keep the fixed bills on one calendar. Easier to see what is really left.
That is the plan. Paycheck hits Friday, then I am splitting rent, index fund, and the down-payment bucket.
Maya wants coffee before dinner. Can you pick her up on your way over?
Yes. Same place near the old high school?
Yes. Robert found the 2017 holiday card too, the one with all four of us in the backyard.
That card needs to stay offline.
Marisol called me by mistake about your packet. She said you still need to answer the assistance-screen page.
I saw it. I marked those boxes as none and uploaded the workplace coverage form.
Okay. Also don't forget to use an actual day off before summer. You keep saving them like points.
I know. I have regular hours and separate sick hours sitting there too, so I'll take a Friday soon.
Maya said you sounded wiped out after the release. Have you eaten yet?
Not yet. Marcus is coming over with tacos and we're going to stare at the rollback plan like it's freshman year again.
Good. If it becomes something that affects your job or apartment, call me and your dad too.
I will. For tonight I just needed someone who can read logs and tell me when I'm overreacting.
Did you actually watch a 38-minute sound test before ordering springs, or was that a bit
It was 1.5x speed. Plus the comments saved me from buying the wrong weight.
Your cart: springs, desk mat, lifting straps, camera clamp. Wardrobe remains at version 0.9.
Version 0.9 is stable. The straps and clamp both solve real problems.
I opened one thread about that council thing and now my phone thinks I want 900 hot takes.
Mute it. I gave myself 12 minutes, saved the city memo, and closed the app before the quote-post war started.
Of course you had a timer.
Timer beats absorbing everyone’s worst paragraph. The memo at least had costs, dates, and who has to run the thing.
If you come by before dinner, can we do Lux for 30 min? I need a break from my spreadsheet life.
Yeah, 4:15. I can stay until Mom starts texting question marks.
Perfect. Also I saved you the Booker meme from last night, it is painfully accurate.
Send it after coffee so I do not laugh in line.
Mom is making me proofread slides about attendance zones. Why are there eight versions named FINAL?
Because every campus sends one more change after she thinks she's done.
Dad just walked in with a 25-year plaque from the warehouse office, so now the kitchen table is portals, plaques, and Mom's old ASU mug.
That sounds like the Hughes family museum. Save the mug before someone stacks freight paperwork on it.
Found your old beanie in my car lol. Do you need it for your dramatic frozen-water quest?
Keep roasting, but yes. I am trying to avoid buying random cold stuff outside the envelope.
Fine, I will bring it Sunday. Also send me one of the blue cave pics when you eventually get them.
Only if I get one that is not blurry from wind or me shivering.
When they come for the filter, ask if they can check the balcony door track too. Easier while maintenance is already there.
I put it in the request notes. I am moving the laptop stand and dumbbells away from the vent before they arrive.
Good. Keep the work area clear so they finish fast.
That is the goal. I blocked the 1-3 window and I am staying here until they leave.
Did you finish that city comment or did you turn it into a product requirements doc
Three bullets: publish stop fields consistently, train on de-escalation with audited outcomes, route some crisis calls to the new team.
PRD confirmed. Also don't forget the apartment background form.
